RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1792862343)

Repairs conditional CoinJoin roster failures involving an unrelated Lightning wallet and oversized Electrum transaction responses. Preserves transaction identity checks and on-chain wallet input protections. Clears stale failure text only after a durably resolved round and adds privacy-safe diagnostic stage codes.

Includes earlier Kilojoin welcome, replay, creator-seat and v4 compatibility repairs, plus logo-tap artwork rotation and existing wallet improvements.

CoinJoin remains Experimental. The reported physical-iPhone join failure is still under investigation; do not treat these regression fixes as confirmation that live mixing works. Hosted native iOS, funded regtest and software tests passed, but they do not establish full mainnet CoinJoin or physical-device interoperability. Review amounts, recipients and fees before signing. Mixing does not guarantee anonymity; the relay can see your IP and your backend can see address queries. Follow the displayed reservation and change recovery steps.
